title: The Boy Nobody Noticed — Part 1
description: Everyone ignored Alex—until a message appeared on his desk. A one-minute Roblox-style mystery story.

scenes.caption: AT THIS SCHOOL, ALEX WAS INVISIBLE.
scenes.narration: At this school, Alex was invisible.

scenes.caption: PEOPLE WALKED PAST HIM EVERY SINGLE DAY.
scenes.narration: People walked past him every single day.

scenes.caption: NO FRIENDS. NO MESSAGES. NOT EVEN A HELLO.
scenes.narration: No friends. No messages. Not even a hello.

scenes.caption: BUT ALEX ALWAYS SAVED ONE SEAT BESIDE HIM.
scenes.narration: But Alex always saved one seat beside him.

scenes.caption: BECAUSE HIS LITTLE BROTHER USED TO SIT THERE.
scenes.narration: Because his little brother used to sit there.

scenes.caption: THEN ONE MORNING, MIA FOUND A NOTE.
scenes.narration: Then one morning, Mia found a note.

scenes.caption: IT WAS HIDDEN INSIDE ALEX'S LOCKER.
scenes.narration: It was hidden inside Alex's locker.

scenes.caption: THE PAPER WAS OLD. THE HANDWRITING WAS FAMILIAR.
scenes.narration: The paper was old. The handwriting was familiar.

scenes.caption: MIA READ THE FIRST LINE… AND FROZE.
scenes.narration: Mia read the first line, and froze.

scenes.caption: ALEX, SOMEONE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR YOU.
scenes.narration: Alex, someone has been looking for you.

scenes.caption: SHE TURNED THE NOTE OVER. ONE LAST MESSAGE.
scenes.narration: She turned the note over. One last message.
